description: This file defines the Control.Attribution class for Leaflet, managing attribution display on maps, including adding/removing attributions, setting prefix, and initializing the control.

classes.name: Control.Attribution
classes.description: A control for displaying attribution information on a Leaflet map, extending the base Control class.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the attribution control with options and sets up internal attribution storage.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Adds the attribution control to the map, creates container, and populates with existing attributions.

methods.name: setPrefix
methods.description: Sets the prefix HTML/text shown before attributions.

methods.name: addAttribution
methods.description: Adds an attribution text to the control.

methods.name: removeAttribution
methods.description: Removes an attribution text from the control.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Updates the attribution display based on current attributions and prefix.
